description: This file is a Python module for managing and interfacing with hardware accelerators in PyTorch, including device management, memory info, streams, and synchronization.

classes.name: device_index
classes.description: Context manager to temporarily set the current device index for the accelerator.

methods.name: device_count
methods.description: Returns the number of available accelerators.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if an accelerator is available at runtime.

methods.name: current_accelerator
methods.description: Returns the current accelerator device at compile time, optionally checking availability.

methods.name: current_device_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently selected device.

methods.name: get_device_capability
methods.description: Returns capability info of a specified device.

methods.name: set_stream
methods.description: Sets the current stream for a device.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes all kernels on a device.
